verdict.rationale: Unleash has a public pricing page (getunleash.io/pricing), and it lists plan features such as export/import, custom activation strategies, and SAML/OIDC SSO. The GitHub README also describes a hosted offering with tiered features. However, none of the cited excerpts show actual prices or explain what drives cost (seats, MAUs, events, or requests). Missing for 10: actual published price points, explicit cost drivers (seats/MAUs/requests), plan-tier comparison detail, independent corroboration of pricing transparency.
